post_start_commands.guest_run: New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard' -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard' -Name 'EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity' -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null

post_start_commands.desc: Enable HVCI (Hypervisor Enforced Code Integrity) scenario
post_start_commands.guest_run: New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity' -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity' -Name 'Enabled' -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null

post_start_commands.desc: Enable Credential Guard without UEFI lock
Set hypervisor launch type to auto (Reboot required)
post_start_commands.guest_run: bcdedit /set hypervisorlaunchtype auto; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "bcdedit failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

$deviceGuard = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_DeviceGuard -Namespace root\Microsoft\Windows\DeviceGuard -ErrorAction Stop; if ($deviceGuard.VirtualizationBasedSecurityStatus -ne 2) { throw "VBS is not running. VirtualizationBasedSecurityStatus: $($deviceGuard.VirtualizationBasedSecurityStatus)" }; Write-Output 'VBS is running'

post_start_commands.desc: Verify HVCI is configured and running
post_start_commands.guest_run: $deviceGuard = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_DeviceGuard -Namespace root\Microsoft\Windows\DeviceGuard -ErrorAction Stop; $configured = @($deviceGuard.SecurityServicesConfigured); $running = @($deviceGuard.SecurityServicesRunning); if (2 -notin $configured) { throw "HVCI is not configured. SecurityServicesConfigured: $($configured -join ', ')" }; if (2 -notin $running) { throw "HVCI is not running. SecurityServicesRunning: $($running -join ', ')" }; Write-Output 'HVCI is configured and running'

post_start_commands.desc: Verify Credential Guard is configured and running
post_start_commands.guest_run: $deviceGuard = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_DeviceGuard -Namespace root\Microsoft\Windows\DeviceGuard -ErrorAction Stop; $configured = @($deviceGuard.SecurityServicesConfigured); $running = @($deviceGuard.SecurityServicesRunning); if (1 -notin $configured) { throw "Credential Guard is not configured. SecurityServicesConfigured: $($configured -join ', ')" }; if (1 -notin $running) { throw "Credential Guard is not running. SecurityServicesRunning: $($running -join ', ')" }; Write-Output 'Credential Guard is configured and running'
